title: PROBA 1/2 Downlink
short: Dump of satellite data to Redu, Belgium ground station from the PROBA (Project for On-Board Autonomy) 1, 2, and V ESA satellites.
desc: The PROBA (**Pr**oject for **O**n-**B**oard **A**utonomy) 1, 2 and V are advanced minisatellites that perform very different tasks on the same architecture.
